purpose: Historical frozen-input evidence; this publication is not a new build, security approval, installed-app acceptance or live-service verification.

originalLocalSourceArchive.reason: Preserved locally unchanged. The shared derivative excludes macOS metadata and files outside the original release input inventories, including runtime project configuration.

sharedSourceArchive.contentPolicy: Exactly the 211 desktop source input files and 8 bundled project review skill input files in verification.json; file bytes, relative paths and permission modes are unchanged. Container timestamps and owners are normalized. No credentials, user profile, runtime project config, private account/history or AppleDouble metadata is included.
